climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A California AVA on the western edge of the Central Valley, on the low Altamont Hills around Tracy. It has limited rain, persistent winds and little fog. Its best-known wines are Italian varieties such as Nero d'Avola, Montepulciano and Sagrantino.
